title: 🧑🏽‍💻 About Me
content: I'm Alfredo Bonilla, Founder of Indie Mind with over 14 years of experience, specializing in AI-driven solutions and agentic coding from Costa Rica.
At Indie Mind, I build AI-first products and services — from multi-agent orchestration systems to content automation pipelines and educational platforms for developers.
My technical expertise spans Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Claude Code, OpenAI, multi-AI orchestration (Opus + Codex), and n8n.

I've built open-source tools like Neural Claude Code (agentic coding framework), Mission Control (AI fleet management), and Cortex (quality gates for AI workflows). On the Web3 side, I've contributed to Cofiblocks, Lago Finance, and Apy-Vision.

My philosophy centers on 'Systems over willpower' - I believe in building automated frameworks and using AI as a co-pilot for technical, creative, and strategic decisions. When I'm not coding, you'll find me enjoying board games with friends, exploring nature, or creating music.
